summary: Hall Chadwick Melbourne is the Melbourne member of the Hall Chadwick group, a mid-market firm at 440 Collins St with about 54 people on LinkedIn. Alan Ling, Director Business Advisory Services, joined from McLean Delmo Bentleys in May 2023 and has 30+ years in tax and advisory. The firm publishes on Payday Super, runs an outsourced back-office and accounting outsourcing team, and has been hiring accountants and supervisors through 2026. Alan was emailed on 23 Nov 2026 (subject 'Quick chat, Alan?').

hooks.text: Payday Super article: firm itself says more frequent reporting and reconciliation will land on payroll and finance systems; reconciliation load rises for clients and for its outsourcing team (new angle for follow-up).
Outsourced accounting/back-office team plus bookkeeping inside CFO Advisory means reconciliation is delivered at volume for clients.
Hiring a Senior Accountant/Supervisor to streamline the tax filing process shows an efficiency mandate.

risks.text: Mid-market group with audit, forensic and insolvency focus; Alan is a tax/business advisory director, not obviously the owner of reconciliation tooling; purchasing may sit with the finance and back-office leader (Peter Pryn is now a consultant).
A first email was already sent to Alan on 23 Nov 2026; keep the follow-up short and different to avoid repetition.

gaps: No podcast/video or personal posts by Alan found; his LinkedIn About is empty.
Could not confirm whether the Payday Super article was authored by Alan (he is listed on the page as a team member).
Content of the 23 Nov first email was not available, so the follow-up avoids referring to its specifics.
Whether Hall Chadwick Melbourne already uses an AI reconciliation tool is unknown; the Emapta offshore case study found relates to the WA firm, not Melbourne.
